# Error reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_contracts.py from backend/app/contracts/error_catalog.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error DisPatch returns carries a stable `error.code`. The HTTP body keeps the
2.x `detail` string and adds the catalogued object:

```json
{"detail": "Thread not found",
 "error": {"code": "thread_not_found", "message": "Thread not found",
           "fix": "Pick a thread from the list; it may have been deleted.",
           "docs": "thread_not_found"}}
```

Branch on `error.code`, never on the message. Machine callers additionally receive an
RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document with the same `error` object.

| Code | HTTP | What it means |

| [`agent_backend_rejected`](#agent_backend_rejected) | 409 | The agent backend refused that request. |
| [`agent_backend_unavailable`](#agent_backend_unavailable) | 503 | The agent backend is not available. |
| [`agent_budget_exhausted`](#agent_budget_exhausted) | 429 | This agent's budget for today is used up. |

## advisor_request_unknown

<a id="advisor_request_unknown"></a>

HTTP **404** - Unknown request

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

## agent_backend_rejected

<a id="agent_backend_rejected"></a>

HTTP **409** - The agent backend refused that request.

**Fix:** The backend cannot do this (for example steer a running OpenClaw turn). Stop the task or wait for it to finish.

## agent_backend_unavailable

<a id="agent_backend_unavailable"></a>

HTTP **503** - The agent backend is not available.

**Fix:** Check Settings, Agents, Backends: OpenClaw must run on this machine, and the Claude Agent needs an API key and the optional agents-claude extra.

## agent_budget_exhausted

<a id="agent_budget_exhausted"></a>

HTTP **429** - This agent's budget for today is used up.

**Fix:** Raise the daily limit in Settings, Agents, or try again tomorrow. Costs are estimates.

## agent_credentials_invalid

<a id="agent_credentials_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - The credentials were not accepted.

**Fix:** Paste an Anthropic Console API key, or pick Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry and configure that provider's own credentials on this machine.

## agent_disabled

<a id="agent_disabled"></a>

HTTP **409** - That agent is switched off.

**Fix:** Switch it on in Settings, Agents.

## agent_gateway_down

<a id="agent_gateway_down"></a>

HTTP **503** - The agent gateway is not connected

**Fix:** Start the OpenClaw gateway, or switch the character to a direct provider.

## agent_has_active_tasks

<a id="agent_has_active_tasks"></a>

HTTP **409** - That agent has tasks that are still running.

**Fix:** Stop or wait for its tasks, or switch the agent off instead of deleting it.

## agent_invalid

<a id="agent_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - The agent definition is not valid.

**Fix:** Fix the field named in the message (a tool list, a budget, an MCP server) and save again.

## agent_name_taken

<a id="agent_name_taken"></a>

HTTP **409** - An agent with that name already exists.

**Fix:** Choose a different name.

## agent_needs_owner

<a id="agent_needs_owner"></a>

HTTP **403** - Only the Owner can give an agent that capability.

**Fix:** Ask the Owner. Running repository hooks, starting local MCP programs and unattended destructive tools are host-level powers.

## agent_not_found

<a id="agent_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Agent not found

**Fix:** Pick an agent from the list; it may be switched off, deleted, or not published to your profile.

## agents_only

<a id="agents_only"></a>

HTTP **403** - Only agents may fire reactions

**Fix:** This endpoint is for agents holding the API key; a signed-in person cannot call it.

## api_key_required

<a id="api_key_required"></a>

HTTP **401** - API key required

**Fix:** Send the API key as X-API-Key.

## approval_not_found

<a id="approval_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - That approval request is not pending any more.

**Fix:** The task moved on (it was stopped, timed out, or someone else answered). Reload the task.

## approval_scope_not_allowed

<a id="approval_scope_not_allowed"></a>

HTTP **422** - That approval can only be given for this one call.

**Fix:** Destructive tools ask every time. Choose 'once'.

## avatar_not_capturable

<a id="avatar_not_capturable"></a>

HTTP **409** - The bot has no capturable avatar right now

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

## avatar_not_found

<a id="avatar_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Avatar not found

**Fix:** The character has no avatar of that kind yet.

## avatar_not_raster

<a id="avatar_not_raster"></a>

HTTP **400** - Avatar must be a raster image

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## avatar_pool_missing

<a id="avatar_pool_missing"></a>

HTTP **404** - No avatar pool for that bot

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

## avatar_snapshot_failed

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## profile_conflict

<a id="profile_conflict"></a>

HTTP **409** - That profile could not be created (duplicate name or second owner).

**Fix:** Choose a different name; there is only ever one owner.

## profile_field_invalid

<a id="profile_field_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - A profile field cannot be set.

**Fix:** Send only fields the People API documents.

## profile_name_invalid

<a id="profile_name_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - A profile name needs 1 to 40 characters.

**Fix:** Use 1 to 40 characters.

## profile_name_taken

<a id="profile_name_taken"></a>

HTTP **409** - A profile named {} already exists.

**Fix:** Choose a different name.

## profile_not_found

<a id="profile_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - No such profile.

**Fix:** Pick a profile from the list; it may have been deleted.

## profile_role_invalid

<a id="profile_role_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - Unknown role {}.

**Fix:** Use owner, admin, member or restricted.

<a id="prompt_bank_malformed"></a>

HTTP **400** - Malformed prompt bank

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## push_subscription_invalid

<a id="push_subscription_invalid"></a>

HTTP **400** - Expected a JSON push subscription

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

## quick_action_target_invalid

<a id="quick_action_target_invalid"></a>

HTTP **422** - bad_action: a quick action applies to user messages

**Fix:** Fix the fields in detail and resend.

## quick_action_unknown

<a id="quick_action_unknown"></a>

HTTP **422** - bad_action: unknown quick action

**Fix:** Fix the fields in detail and resend.

**Fix:** This profile is not available at this time of day. Ask the Owner to change quiet hours.

HTTP **429** - Rate limited.

**Fix:** Slow down and retry after a moment.

**Fix:** Reload the reaction pack.

## recovery_needs_new_pin

HTTP **409** - Choose a new PIN: other people have profiles here, so the lock cannot simply be removed.

**Fix:** Enter the recovery code together with a new PIN (4 or more characters).

## refresh_running

<a id="refresh_running"></a>

HTTP **409** - A refresh is already running for this tool

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

## remember_device_required

<a id="remember_device_required"></a>

HTTP **403** - Notifications need a remembered device: lock, then unlock with "Remember this device" ticked.

**Fix:** Sign out and in again with "Remember this device" ticked to get notifications.

## reply_in_progress_delete

<a id="reply_in_progress_delete"></a>

HTTP **409** - Cannot delete messages while a reply is in progress

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

## reply_in_progress_edit

<a id="reply_in_progress_edit"></a>

HTTP **409** - Cannot edit messages while a reply is in progress

**Fix:** The state conflicts with the request; reload and retry.

## route_undeclared

<a id="route_undeclared"></a>

HTTP **403** - This endpoint has no access policy.

**Fix:** This is a bug: the endpoint has no declared permission. Report it; it is refused until it has one.

## safe_mode

<a id="safe_mode"></a>

HTTP **403** - Unlock for full access

**Fix:** Sign in as a profile that is allowed to do this (Settings > People & Profiles), or ask the Owner. Restricted profiles and signed-out devices can only chat with characters made for them.

**Fix:** The thing you asked for does not exist; reload and pick it again.

**Fix:** Check the request and resend it.

<a id="setup_forbidden"></a>

HTTP **403** - Setup is only allowed from this computer or with the setup token.

**Fix:** Open DisPatch on the computer it runs on, or send the one-time setup token from the server log.

## setup_required

<a id="setup_required"></a>

HTTP **403** - This DisPatch has no owner yet. Open it on the computer it runs on, or finish setup with the one-time setup token from the server log.

**Fix:** Open DisPatch on the computer it runs on, or finish setup with the one-time setup token printed in the server log (POST /api/auth/setup).

## signin_required

<a id="signin_required"></a>

HTTP **401** - Sign in to continue.

**Fix:** Pick your profile and enter your PIN or password. The owner can allow signed-out use with anonymous_access: restricted in security.yaml.

## stalled

<a id="stalled"></a>

HTTP **502** - The image render stalled.

**Fix:** The render started and then went quiet. DisPatch retries once; if it keeps stalling, restart the image server.

<a id="starter_pack_not_found"></a>

HTTP **404** - Unknown starter pack

**Fix:** List the packs with GET /api/starter-packs.
